changes.before: 보건소 금연클리닉은 무료로 상담합니다. 지역금연지원센터도 무료입니다. 상담전화는 무료로 이용할 수 있습니다. 병·의원 약물치료는 국민건강보험공단의 금연치료 지원사업을 이용하세요. 진료·상담비는 3회차부터 내지 않고 과정을 마치면 낸 돈을 전부 돌려받습니다. 자세한 조건은 제3항(금연약)에 있습니다. 행동 지원 상담은 보통 4~8회 받습니다. 한 번에 30분~1시간 걸립니다. 총 상담 시간은 대개 5시간 안입니다.

quotes: Behavioural support was typically provided by specialists in cessation counselling, who offered between four and eight contact sessions. The planned maximum duration of contact was typically more than 30 minutes but less than 300 minutes.

Based on the remaining 52 studies (19,488 participants) there was high quality evidence (using GRADE) for a benefit of combined pharmacotherapy and behavioural treatment compared to usual care, brief advice or less intensive behavioural support (RR 1.83, 95% CI 1.68 to 1.98) with moderate statistical heterogeneity (I² = 36%).
The main outcome measure was abstinence from smoking after at least six months of follow-up.

quotes: Among trials including smokers who contacted helplines (32,484 participants), quit rates were higher for smokers receiving multiple sessions of proactive counselling (risk ratio (RR) 1.38, 95% confidence interval (CI) 1.19 to 1.61; 14 trials, 32,484 participants; I<sup>2</sup> = 72%) compared with a control condition providing self-help materials or brief counselling in a single call. Due to the substantial unexplained heterogeneity between studies, we downgraded the certainty of the evidence to moderate.

In studies that recruited smokers who did not call a helpline, the provision of telephone counselling increased quit rates (RR 1.25, 95% CI 1.15 to 1.35; 65 trials, 41,233 participants; I<sup>2</sup> = 52%). Due to the substantial unexplained heterogeneity between studies, we downgraded the certainty of the evidence to moderate.
